## What's free

AuraDB Free: 200k nodes, 400k relationships, 1 GB storage; managed graph database

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://neo4j.com/pricing/> before relying on this.

## Notes

Free instances auto-pause when inactive and have no backups. The Terraform provider is a Neo4j Labs project (unsupported); check that the Aura API can manage Free instances.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
